name: Bot Mode
summary: Hermes Agent's built-in Bot Mode: profiles become named bots, each with its own persistent chat, model, memory and skills.
description: A user-guide page for Bot Mode in the Hermes Agent desktop app, where it is on by default as a Bots tab beside Sessions in the left sidebar. A bot is a Hermes profile — isolated config, memory, skills, credentials and chat history under ~/.hermes/profiles/<name>/ — and Bot Mode adds one permanent Bot Chat per bot, avatars, voices, recurring routines, group chats, bot-to-bot messaging, sections and CLI parity.
contains: Bot Mode is built into the desktop app and on by default
a bot is a Hermes profile: isolated config, memory, skills, credentials and chat history
one permanent Bot Chat per bot; /new is rerouted to /compact
routines are scheduled beside each chat and appear in hermes cron list
group chats, bot-to-bot messaging and a cross-machine relay
roster with avatars, sections, search, hiding and an activity filter
